print(sales.dtypes)

print("\nUnique values in `converted`:")
print(sales['converted'].unique())

print("\nSummary of `customer_age`:")
print(sales['customer_age'].describe())

print("\nCount of `customer_age` == -1:")
print((sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

print("\nSample of `revenue`:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))"}
